expected_parent_change: One execution does not identify an action; it eliminates every reading of the action that contradicts it, and the survivors are a set. Measured on 7 real actions with 343 readings each in a stated grammar over a real directory: one execution settles 5 of 7 on the states the task reaches, and 2 of 7 are left with survivors that agree on every state the task reaches and DISAGREE outside it. `sort` and `sort -u` both survive a duplicate-free list; the one-shot learner that keeps the first survivor is right on the task and wrong on 5 further states across 2 actions the moment a duplicate appears. Repeating the same execution changed the verdict on 0 of 7 actions: doing it twice is the same evidence as doing it once. One action (`sort -R`) looked perfectly learnable after one execution (7 survivors) and was contradicted by the second, so the answer is REFUSE, not a memorised guess. The decision rule is three-way and computable before the second execution: act when every survivor agrees, spend one execution at the state that splits them, refuse when no reading fits. The tree's own coding measurement shows the same wall an order of magnitude larger: median 1037 surviving programs after one demonstration (max 16480), 4 of 23 tasks identified, 7 of 23 insufficient even after every example.
expected_parent_frontier_change: Five real actions, five distinct outcomes, nothing asserted: `cp payload.dat out.dat` is EXPLAINED and grows nothing (the negative control); `touch keep.dat` is INVISIBLE to the content view and is silently accepted as identity, repaired by the derived predicate `mtime_changed` because the raw timestamp field reported the action in only 5 of 6 unnormalised repeats; `sort -R payload.dat -o out.dat` is not a function of its state and is repaired by a set-valued consequence `PERMUTATION_OF_INPUT(payload.dat)`, the strongest relation every repeat satisfies, stable on a fresh execution, excluding `sort_unique` while admitting identity/copy/sort/reverse (the price, printed); `sort -u -r payload.dat -o out.dat` is outside the flat grammar (0 of 73 readings reproduce it) and is repaired by one composition `sort_unique_then_reverse`; and `mkdir newdir` is BEYOND THIS OBSERVABLE -- the effect is on disk and every one of the five views is empty, so no predicate built from the same readings can reach it and the loop refuses to grow. The frontier's claim that a system can invent the concepts it needs is therefore half true and the false half is now located: predicates, sets and compositions are derivable from within the state; a missing sensor is not, and must be requested from the interface
explicit_user_authorization: Is instant learning a complete solution for all computer use and the most advanced software engineering? What is real and what is not?
What is the single bottleneck that, if fixed, unlocks the most capability?
Own weights from scratch, every parameter calculated, an instant knowledge source, and the best part is no part.
Hardest real tests only, never synthetic; integrity real; no self-congratulation; merge once when complete.
falsification_condition: This round is false if any growth here is not forced: if a flat reading reproduces `sort -u -r`, if the permutation relation admits a consequence the action never produced, if `delta_mtime` fires on the contrast `true`, if the `touch` case were explainable by identity at every state, or if a predicate built from the same five views could reach `mkdir`. Each is asserted in the tests against real executions

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The coding barrier is not candidate generation and not memory -- the previous rounds closed those to their measured limits. It is that a failure outside the vocabulary is terminal: the system can say 'no reading explains this' and has nothing to do with that answer. This round makes the failure decide the growth and keeps only growth that survives four executable checks, so a refusal costs one diagnosis instead of being permanent; but it also locates the part that no diagnosis can repair -- a missing observation -- which is why the forecast stays at 1/100 rather than rising.

obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: intrinsic: what a set of observations determines is a fact about the action and the observations, not about the learner. Either the survivors agree on the states in reach or they do not.
obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: One execution leaves a set of readings that agree on the observed state. For real actions that set is larger than one (343 readings in the grammar here, median 1037 candidate programs in the tree's coding measurement), and the readings part company only on states the observation never touched -- which is why the failure is invisible exactly where it happens.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Discovery costs one subprocess per (step, candidate path) and buys the difference between redoing 8 steps and redoing 14, or worse, redoing 1 wrong step and declaring the work repaired.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rule is not about tar: any step is a function of the state it can see, so perturbing a candidate and comparing the consequence yields its read set on a GUI, a database or a network service with the matching probe.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Reading the read set off argv is wrong in both directions and fails 2 of 3 real chains; tracing requires infrastructure that does not exist here and annotates what must be discovered; asking a model is prohibited producer cognition; redoing everything works and costs 75% more, and does not tell the agent what to redo when the state is too large to rebuild.

obs_solution.white_box_harvest_note: The canonical ladder was applied in order; WHITE_BOX_HARVEST was considered and found empty. No donor model, weight or external artifact was used: the rule is a counterfactual on the tree's own action environment.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: No synthetic case decides anything: every observation is a real subprocess on a real copy of a real state, and the refusal is produced by a real `sort -R` contradicting its own first execution.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: The unit of permanent knowledge is the survivor set, not the chosen reading: after an execution the agent keeps every transformation the observation did not rule out and decides with three cases -- act when all survivors agree on the states in reach, spend one execution at the state that splits them, refuse when none fits. Nothing is trained, and the knowledge is regenerated from the state and the grammar.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Given one real execution of an action on a real state, decide whether that execution identified the action: filter a generated grammar of state transformations, compare the survivors on the states the work can reach, and answer act / ask-once-more-at-this-state / refuse -- before spending the second execution.

route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Four routes were refused on measurement: one-hypothesis learning (right on the task and wrong on 5 further states across 2 of 7 actions), repetition (0 of 7 verdicts changed), blind abstention (the frontier's 59.5% paired accuracy with act exceeding abstain by 21 points), and model-proposed repair (prohibited producer cognition).
